p: Sinai: In the place in the wilderness that was near mount Sinai.
second month: Which is part of April and part of May.
man of every tribe: That is, the chiefest man of every tribe.
stand with you: And afflict you when you number the people.
princes of the tribes of their: Or captains, and governors.
their pedigrees after their families: In showing every man his tribe and his ancestors.
them: Which were warriors, but were appointed to the use of the Tabernacle.
stranger that cometh nigh shall be: Whoever is not of the tribe of Levi.
upon the congregation of the children: By not having due regard to the tabernacle of the Lord.
